I need one thing to pull it up: your order number, or the email on the order. Either works, then I'll tell you exactly where the remaining part stands and what date it ships.
I'm close to a chargeback, no one answers my emails
Handed to the team · Chargeback threat, needs a person; no identifier yet to match the order.

Meanwhile I can still check it myself. Give me your order number or the email on the order and I'll tell you where that part stands and its ship date right now.

Fair. Then let me actually answer you instead of promising someone else will.
